name: Family Sponsorship (Spouse & Children)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires the sponsor to earn at least AED 4,000/month, or AED 3,000/month plus employer-provided accommodation.
This covers spouse, unmarried daughters (no age limit), sons under 25, and children with special needs.

evidence_required.document: Sponsor's income evidence meeting the threshold

sources.title: Residence visa for family members - The Official Portal of the UAE Government (updated 27 Feb 2026)

notes: Job-title restrictions on the AED 4,000 threshold were removed in the 2019/2022 reform — the same figure applies regardless of the sponsor's occupation. Six-month grace period on the sponsor's cancellation/expiry, giving dependants time to secure independent status. Sponsored spouse may work with their OWN separate work permit — sponsorship status itself doesn't need to change for the spouse to be employed, a genuine flexibility worth surfacing. A UAE citizen's foreign spouse/parent/child can get a 5-year residence visa without working; a foreign widow/divorcee who is mother of a UAE citizen can be sponsored by her oldest child — narrow but real special-case provisions not modeled as separate groups here given scope. Emirate variation flagged: female-sponsor income thresholds reportedly differ (Dubai AED 4,000 vs higher figures in Abu Dhabi per some tier-3 sources) — not independently confirmed at tier-1 precision, flagged as a gap rather than guessed.
